fact: Which company acquired Verve Therapeutics? Eli Lilly
When was Lilly's acquisition of Verve completed? 25 July 2025
What per-share price did Lilly pay for Verve? $10.50 plus a CVR worth up to $3
quote: Terms were $10.50 per share, roughly $1B, plus one non-tradeable contingent value right per share worth up to a further $3.

fact: What is Verve's lead programme, continuing under Lilly? VERVE-102
quote: VERVE-102 — a potential first-in-class in vivo base editor

fact: Which gene does VERVE-102 target? PCSK9
quote: in vivo base editor targeting PCSK9

fact: For which disease is VERVE-102 developed? Atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease
What triggers payment of Verve's contingent value right? First patient dosed in a US Phase 3 within ten years
quote: The CVR pays only if the first patient is dosed with VERVE-102 in a US Phase 3 trial

fact: Which company's technology does Verve's base editing trace to? Beam Therapeutics
quote: The technology traces to Beam Therapeutics

fact: What was Verve's founding thesis? One treatment could permanently lower cholesterol
quote: a single treatment could permanently lower cholesterol instead of requiring lifelong statins
